python3 -c "
import json
lines = open('/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/outputs/70b_lora_scierc_grammar_only.jsonl').readlines()
print(f'Total docs: {len(lines)}')
parse_fail = 0
total_rels = 0
rv_viol = 0
et_viol = 0
dr_viol = 0
cf_viol = 0
valid_types = {'Method','Task','Material','Metric','OtherScientificTerm','Generic'}
valid_rels = {'Used-for','Feature-of','Hyponym-of','Part-of','Compare','Conjunction','Evaluate-for'}
domain_range = {'Used-for':[('Method','Task'),('Method','Method')],'Feature-of':[('Method','Task'),('Method','Method'),('OtherScientificTerm','Method'),('OtherScientificTerm','Material')],'Hyponym-of':[('Method','Method'),('Task','Task'),('Material','Material'),('Metric','Metric'),('OtherScientificTerm','OtherScientificTerm')],'Part-of':[('Method','Method'),('Task','Task'),('Material','Material'),('OtherScientificTerm','OtherScientificTerm')],'Compare':[('Method','Method'),('Material','Material'),('Metric','Metric')],'Conjunction':[('Method','Method'),('Task','Task'),('Material','Material'),('Metric','Metric'),('OtherScientificTerm','OtherScientificTerm'),('Generic','Generic')],'Evaluate-for':[('Metric','Method'),('Metric','Task')]}
for line in lines:
    d = json.loads(line)
    p = d.get('parsed_output')
    if p is None:
        parse_fail += 1
        continue
    ents = p.get('entities',[])
    rels = p.get('relations',[])
    ent_map = {e['text']:e['type'] for e in ents}
    for e in ents:
        if e['type'] not in valid_types:
            et_viol += 1
    for r in rels:
        total_rels += 1
        rt = r.get('type','')
        if rt not in valid_rels:
            rv_viol += 1
            continue
        ht = r.get('head_type','')
        tt = r.get('tail_type','')
        if rt in domain_range and (ht,tt) not in domain_range[rt]:
            dr_viol += 1
        h_name = r.get('head','')
        t_name = r.get('tail','')
        if h_name in ent_map and ent_map[h_name] != ht:
            cf_viol += 1
        if t_name in ent_map and ent_map[t_name] != tt:
            cf_viol += 1
print(f'Parse failures: {parse_fail}')
print(f'Total relations: {total_rels}')
print(f'ET violations: {et_viol}')
print(f'RV violations: {rv_viol}')
print(f'DR violations: {dr_viol}')
print(f'CF violations: {cf_viol}')
if total_rels > 0:
    print(f'DR rate: {dr_viol/total_rels*100:.2f}%')
    print(f'CF rate: {cf_viol/total_rels*100:.2f}%')
"

3	OntoCoDec translates IE ontologies into composable token-level constraints.
4	LoRA + greedy S1 near-eliminates DR ($<$\,0.1\%) with CF\,$\leq$\,1.4\%; beam ($k{=}4$) eliminates all violations on both RE datasets (1.54$\times$ latency); zero-shot DR drops 42--99\% across three 8B-class models.
5	The central insight is that IE type constraints exceed context-free expressiveness (Proposition~1): the semantic layer's entity registry provides random-access type lookups and forward masking~\cite{scholak2021picard,khorshidi2025odke}, bridging the gap grammar-only enforcement cannot address (3\% vs.\ 94\% DR reduction); this enabling dependency---scale-sensitive (\S\ref{sec:70b-results})---shows grammar-constrained decoding is necessary but insufficient for IE schema compliance.
6	Residual CF arises from per-triple independent enforcement; beam search resolves this (\S\ref{sec:beam-results}).
